That was wrong — the email landed at 8:52 AM from the other alias, subject "Weekly Pipeline & Forecast — Monday, August 3," leading with "THE COUNT IS SETTLED: GENE = 21. ACCOUNT-WIDE = 35." Build #1, the item three straight CEO Sweeps called the fleet's worst bug, appears to have run end to end for the first time in roughly 21 days. Verify it in your inbox before closing the task.

A separate p1 has already triaged it to 4 genuinely held leads and 1 stale ownership verdict. ⚠️ AND THE ✅ GENE'S LEAD STAMP ON A REPLAYED ALERT IS NOT A RULE-0 PASS: a second p1 raised today says the responder's ownership check cannot see the lead pond. Verify Assigned-To on the person page before any outbound, exactly as the five ad leads already require.

🔴 TWO ROUTINES DIED SILENTLY TODAY AND BOTH WERE CAUGHT LATE, NOT BY THEMSELVES. The 8:05 AM Monday Review Preview produced zero log lines and was only noticed on a catch-up run around 4:15 PM; three of its client drafts are still unsent and need you. It shipped its own guards in response — a run-start heartbeat and a Monday watchdog — which is the right fix, but the pattern is the same one Build #3 has been queued for since 7/26: the fleet loses a run and finds out afterward. ✅ Set against that, eleven routines fired clean today and no BLOCKED line has been written in 24 hours.
